fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded checkpoint set ~250 m down a private access road off SR-138. z19 satellite shows a small booth in the road median with inbound/outbound lanes splitting around it and a semi stopped at the checkpoint. SV from the inner staging lot (2015-09) shows Walmart trailers and the DC dock face.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small square booth (~1-2 stall footprint) sitting in the median of the gate, lanes split around it (z19 crop wm11-guard-z19).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved approach apron and shoulder room between SR-138 and the gate where trucks can wait.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved staging/check-in lot inside the gate before the dock doors; SV shows trailers staged here.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: ~250 m private access road from SR-138 to the gate, easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound; lanes split around the booth but exact count is approximate from overhead.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and long approach road with ample unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1.2M sqft cross-dock RDC with dock doors and backed-in trailers along both long faces; well over 50 (estimate ~120).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of drop trailers in marked rows filling the SW, S, and N yards; far exceeds 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct long building faces (SW and NE), consistent with separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site west of Grantsville surrounded by open desert/farmland and mountains; a residential subdivision abuts the SE corner but the broader setting is rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but adjacent to a growing subdivision and on a state highway, so cellular coverage is likely adequate; low-confidence inference.
fieldNotes.scale: No distinct truck-scale pad identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated multi-acre trailer-storage rows wrap the building on three sides.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter polygon tracing the graded/paved property edge (~146 acres).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count of trailers visible across captured imagery; honest estimate, hundreds present.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.
